■ Stage Direction
Recalling her own past statement and feeling a sense of contradiction/unease.

Don't treat me like a stranger!
Even a Trainer's allowed to lean on their Umamusume!

This is for Biko Pegasus's sake too.
I want to watch over her special training up close.

Yeah, exactly!
Leave tonight to me, and just kick back and enjoy the barbecue!

...Is that... true?
...Hmm...

Trainer, are you okay?
Are you feeling down, by any chance...?

All right, let's keep this up all the way to the goal...!
You can do it, Trainer! Let's clear it together!

"Rely on your allies to recharge your spirit's energy!
And then let us fight side by side, Radishman!"

This is pretty rough on you, isn't it, Trainer? Go take a rest in the shade!
I can handle everything from here on my own!
Huh—oh, it's nothing!

That way, we'll fill our energy to the max,
and we can give training our all again tomorrow!

Ooh! How dependable!
All right, I won't let myself be outdone either!

It's no problem at all!
You spent so much time helping me with my special training today, Trainer!

To tell the truth, I got carried away trying to keep up with her special training.
I can't hide the fatigue, but...

Surprised, huh!
This is my special training ground.

Got it! I'll take care of all the barbecue prep!
So Trainer, just sit back and relax!

O-Oooooh! That sounds super cool!
I see... All right then, let's do this, Trainer!

Even the greatest hero of all to me...
Carrotman said so himself!

Relying on someone isn't pathetic at all!
Because—leaning on others is nourishment for the soul!

Right! That's it!
So—so, uh...?
Just like this—hya!

All right! I'm gonna take on the Hard Course!
...Ah, but... hmm...

"Go, our Justice Biko~♪
Become the hope of this Earth~♪"

One day during my day off while out in the city,
I spotted Biko Pegasus.

"To protect the smiles of as many people as possible,
we cannot afford to lose. That is why—"

You mean you can't show weakness in front of me because you're my Trainer?
...Hmph.

Heheh, I'm just getting started! ...Oh, there's another
fun-looking one over there! Wanna go try it, Trainer?!

Huh, really?!
...N-No, but you shouldn't push yourself, okay?

That last obstacle course was incredible!
Bouldering straight up a cliff-like wall like that!

Ever since Dad showed me this place when I was little,
we've been doing special training here together!

Yeah... So being my Trainer doesn't matter.
I want you to rely on me!
—Pegasus Punch!

Oh! What a coincidence, Trainer.
Actually, I'm just on my way to do some "Secret Training"!
(...Huh? Wait, could it be that I'm—)

Suddenly, a sign labeled "Hard Course" catches my eye.
It seems Biko Pegasus noticed it as well—

If you exercise with all your might out in nature,
you'll build a strong body just like a hero—

"It is fine, are we not best friends?
Leaning on your comrades is nothing to be ashamed of."

She cheers me on with earnest passion. She must have been doing special training
like this since she was little to become a hero.

To be sure, for someone like me who doesn't exercise much normally,
even that previous course was intense... However.

Oh, right! Why don't you come along too, Trainer?
I'm sure it'll be a blast!

...To make her dream of becoming a hero come true.
For that, I want to stick with her through this "Secret Training" to the very end.

! ...Yeah, thanks! But I'm okay,
because heroes don't lean on other people!

After that, I accompanied Biko Pegasus
in her special training until the sun went down—

With that, Biko Pegasus scrambled up
the log tower in the blink of an eye!

Ah, Trainer! Heheh...
While I was on justice patrol, I heard the call for a hero!

And to wrap it all up, it's barbecue timeee!!
Hey, hey, Trainer! Where are the grilled carrots...?

"Guh, the wounds from the enemy ache...! 
Ha ha, how pathetic of me. To cause you such trouble..."

Hup, step, jump!
—How's that? "Wobbly Bridge" cleared!

When you're out of energy, you borrow strength from your friends to get stronger.
That's how heroes can fight against any evil!

And so, the place Biko Pegasus led me to
turned out to be—

Yay, cleared it!
How'd you like a taste of our power?!
